correctness.rationale: The projector splitting P0+(E-P0)+sum Q_i has Laplacian eigenvalues 0,N,N-n_i. All cross-part entries equal h phi(Nh)/24; same-part offdiagonal entries have positive h^2q/24 times a quadratic with negative discriminant -16(2p^2+5pq+5q^2). R(-x) has a strictly positive sum-of-squares form. phi is strictly decreasing, and N is attained, so both sign and real symmetric 2-norm contractivity have exactly the same sharp cutoff; h=0 and singleton parts handled. Fresh symbolic identities and 492 exact rational entries checked (six graphs, four scaled h). Finite examples do not prove all partitions; projector/inequality proof does.
residual_risks: Finite calculations are not universal proofs; precise proof lemmas assessed separately.
